Overview, permissions, privacy and Android blocks
aistudio.google.com/apikey • two taps to create the key
Sign in with your Google account, tap Create API key, copy it and paste it in the field below. The free tier covers everyday use.
Tap Fetch models for my key to load the list
The list comes from the Gemini API itself: only models your key can use for text show up. The result is saved until you fetch again or change keys.
Connection valid, but the model %1$s isn\'t available for this key: pick one from the list.

The choice applies to the whole app and takes effect right away.
What the app does and how it works
An AI bar above your keyboard
The app doesn\'t replace your keyboard: it draws a bar right above it, with shortcuts to fix, improve, translate, change the tone, summarize, rewrite and dictate.

The bar shows in any text field, except in banking and payment apps, where it stays off for safety (in Settings > All apps you choose other apps). Tap an action and the AI returns the text already applied, with Undo on the bar.
In Functions you create shortcuts with your own prompts, pick the emoji, reorder by dragging and pin your favorites.

You choose the engine: Gemini, straight with your key and no middle server, or an AI model that runs on the device itself (.litertlm or .gguf files), with no internet. The engine in use shows at the top of the Assistant.
If the bar covers a message, drag it by the handle on the left, or tap the down arrow to shrink everything into a small button.
Knowing when the keyboard is open
Android doesn\'t report the height of a third-party keyboard any other way. The service uses it to anchor the bar above the keys.
Reading the focused field when you ask
Reading only happens when you tap a shortcut, to send that text to the AI.
Replacing the text after your action
The swap uses Android\'s standard editing action and only runs after your tap.
The app doesn\'t declare itself an accessibility tool, doesn\'t log taps, doesn\'t record audio in the background and doesn\'t send your text over the internet without an action from you.
Text only leaves when you tap
No automatic action sends what you type: the AI receives the text only when you run a shortcut.
With Gemini, the text goes straight to Google\'s server with your key: there is no app server in between, no analytics and no telemetry. With offline AI, the text never leaves the phone.
The key stays encrypted on the device
It is stored with AES/GCM 256 using a key generated in the Android Keystore, which never leaves the device.
The app keeps no history of the messages that pass through the bar: the text is used and discarded.
Dictation uses Android\'s own recognizer. The audio isn\'t sent to Gemini, only the transcribed text.
This happens with every APK installed outside the Play Store, because it hasn\'t gone through Google\'s review. Tap More details and Install anyway.
Since Android 13, apps installed outside the store start with restricted settings off. Open the app info, tap the three dots and choose Allow restricted settings.

Almost always it is battery saving closing the app in the background, common on Xiaomi, Poco, Oppo and similar phones. In Settings > Permissions there are shortcuts for autostart and unrestricted battery.

Turn the AI bar off in specific apps
Known banks, digital wallets and brokers: the bar doesn\'t appear and no text is read.
Did your bank ask you to uninstall?

Some banks refuse to open while any accessibility service installed outside the Play Store is on. That\'s the bank\'s rule, and the app can\'t hide it. Turn the service off before opening your bank app and turn it back on afterwards.
Does the service turn itself off?

Xiaomi, Redmi, Poco, Oppo, Realme, OnePlus and vivo phones close background apps. Enable autostart, set the app\'s battery to No restrictions, lock the app in the recents screen, then turn accessibility off and on again.
Android stopped the service. Turn it off and on again in Accessibility.
If the AI bar causes any problem in an app, you can turn it off just there from here. Pick any installed app: the bar won\'t show up in it and no text is read.

AI engine at the top of the Assistant: the one in use shows Online and the other, disabled, shows Offline. Tap the disabled one to turn it on; hold to configure.
More stable Gemini: if a model is overloaded or out of quota, the app tries others on its own, and the model list only shows the ones that work.
Dictation corrected in real time: at each pause, the part you just said is already punctuated and fixed. Finishing is almost instant.
The text\'s language is respected: Fix, Improve, Summarize, Change tone and your functions keep the language you wrote in, even after translating.
